given: An 8-person standup on Zoom with heavy cross-talk; speaker-attributed transcript fans out per turn.
when: Mid-sentence Dana says 'we should proxy that through the gateway' and, two turns later, Raj says 'Proxy, is chargeCard still called anywhere?'
then: The mechanical name-gate does NOT wake on Dana's 'proxy' (one tiny disambiguation call resolves it to proxy-server, no ack), but DOES wake on Raj's addressed ask, firing the ack reflex and a grounded direct-answer — one clean speaker's turn, no cross-talk mis-attribution.
